scope: Reconstructed 2025-12-31 fixed cohort; not historical membership at every date. Independent full roster validation remains limited; corrections are explicit.
selection: Keep original 30; sector-proportional largest-remainder 70 additions, ranked by SHA256(Han-expansion-v1/issuer_id); alternate hash order into 35 training and 35 held companies. One lexicographically first listed class per CIK.
missing_policy: No fabricated/forward-filled prices. Record download/identity/coverage failures, never replace selected firms based on outcomes. Shorter histories allowed after full past context.
model_scope: Market-only pooled Ridge and LSTM trained on original+new_training firms; held_company labels excluded from training, selection and calibration. Existing pretrained models remain retrospective comparators.
